_source: Pulled from the live ntknews.org stylesheet and computed styles, 2026-10-27. tokens.css is the implementation; this file is the same values for Python or Pulse.

serif.use: headlines (600), body (400), amber italic accent (600 italic), small-caps section labels (400)

sans.use: eyebrows/kickers (600 uppercase, +0.1em), buttons (600), URLs and meta (600/700)

motifs: Ink hero: cream Newsreader headline with an amber italic accent ("Get clear on what's news.")
Amber dot + amber Overpass caps eyebrow for the edition date
Cream card overlapping a duotone photo, coral-deep eyebrow, Newsreader headline, Overpass bold link
Story rows: left rule whose weight encodes Truths / Probabilities / Possibilities / Lies
Backstory: vertical timeline of years, ending in a coral ring marked 'Today' / 'You came in here'
Amber primary buttons with ink text; ink buttons on amber
